code:
-- Physical upgrade happens first.
-- Compatibility level stays put by default:

ALTER DATABASE Sales
  SET COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL = 140; -- old level, kept on purpose

-- Raise it later, as its own tested step:
ALTER DATABASE Sales
  SET COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL = 160;
caption: New engine now, new optimizer behavior later — deliberately.
